# Introduction to Pharmacokinetics

Pharmacokinetics describes how the body affects a drug over time [@Rowland2011]. The four classic phases are absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion [@Rowland2011, p. 12].

## Absorption

Oral bioavailability is governed by first-pass metabolism [@Wilkinson1975]. When a drug is taken orally, a fraction is lost to hepatic enzymes before reaching systemic circulation.

## Distribution
